# ros2_control Documentation

> ros2_control is a framework for real-time control of robots using 
> ROS 2. It provides hardware abstraction, a controller manager, 
> and a set of standard controllers for common robot hardware.

## Key Sections

- [Getting Started](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/getting_started/getting_started.html)
- [Controllers](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/ros2_controllers/doc/controllers_index.html)
- [Demos](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/ros2_control_demos/doc/index.html)
- [Hardware Components](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/ros2_control/doc/index.html)
- [Utilities](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/utilities.html)
- [Simulator Integration](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/simulators/simulators.html)
- [Supported Robotics](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/supported_robots/supported_robots.html)

- [Migration Guides](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/migration/migration.html)
- [Release Notes](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/release_notes/release_notes.html)
- [API Reference](https://control.ros.org/rolling/doc/api_list/api_list.html)

## Supported ROS 2 Versions

- Rolling (development): https://control.ros.org/rolling/
- Lyrical (development): https://control.ros.org/lyrical/
- Kilted: https://control.ros.org/kilted/
- Jazzy: https://control.ros.org/jazzy/
- Humble: https://control.ros.org/humble/
